content_fields.title: Test application and webhook security strategies (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify the application and webhook security controls on this repository.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means reviewing the installed application list against the approved set, confirming each grant is least privilege, and confirming every webhook uses a secret and HTTPS with signature verification at the receiver.
content_fields.found: No webhook receivers or application manifests exist in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Access to the hosting platform's settings, where installations and webhooks are configured.
content_fields.conclusion: The evidence for this verification lives in platform settings rather than repository content.
content_fields.action: The repository administrators should perform the review in the platform settings and record the outcome.
